description: Search contractor licenses (California by default; pass state for others) three ways. (1) By business name, as written on a quote, invoice, truck or website: typos, word forms (plumber/plumbing), missing words and Inc/LLC are handled, and other names on the CSLB record are matched too (other_business_names lists the ones that are business names). Each match has a match_level (exact, strong, partial) and says what it matched on. (2) By license number. (3) With no name, by trade and/or city to list licensed contractors. The trade can be a description of the job ("my AC is blowing warm air", "sewage backing up"); read_as says how it was read. Lists: clear licenses only by default, in a shuffled order fixed until the next data refresh, 10 per page, up to 5 pages. Lists are not rankings or recommendations. A name match is not proof of identity, so give the user the license number and ask them to confirm it with the contractor. With no state, the state is read from the city ("Seattle, WA", a ZIP, or a city only one state's records list), and a name with no close California match is tried in every state. A question ("is 50% upfront legal", "contractor took my deposit") is not searched: mode is question, with guides that answer it.

city.description: City or ZIP code, e.g. "Oakland", "Oakland, CA" or "94704".

license.description: CSLB license number, if you have one.

name.description: Business name or part of it, e.g. "Diamond Plumbing". Leave out to list by trade and/or city.

state.description: Two-letter state code. Default CA. License records: CO, CT, FL, IL, KS, MN, NY, OR, PA, TX, VA, WA. City permit records only (record_type permits_only, no state license data): AZ, GA, HI, LA, MA, MI, NC, NV, OH, TN.

status.description: For lists: clear (default) or all, which includes suspended and other licenses.

trade.description: Trade in plain words or a CSLB code, e.g. "plumbing", "furnace", "water heater", "sewer line", "C-36".

work.description: California lists only: a kind of work from city permits, e.g. "water heater", "heat pump", "sewer". Lists only contractors with San Francisco permits for that work in the last five years.

name: search_licenses

outputSchema.description: Matches for a name or license number, or a shuffled list for a trade and city.

data_as_of.description: Date the data was copied from the agency, YYYY-MM-DD.

guides.description: mode question: guides that answer the question (title, url).

id.description: Other states: the id to pass to get_license.

read_as.description: How a plain-language trade or job description was read.

state_inferred.description: With no state given: which state was searched and why.

title: Search contractor licenses
